mutants.description: settle decision taken on a speculative read (a guess) in place of the acquire read, at both decisions (L5 and L8)
mutants.form: ambiguous (the plan does not say which decision): the acquire re-read of both decisions of a load, the one of count_and_settle (L5) and the one of settle (L8), is replaced by a speculative read (a guess); the simulator's guess is exact, the torn policy of the unit suites is not. mutants.note: the record of the first review says the unit suites (torn policy) catch it; no suite does when the scheduling point of the re-read stays, because the guess of the simulator is exact and a torn guess must hit a rare interleaving to give a wrong decision
